candidates.evidence: Cabinet Decision No. 39 (17 Feb 2021), nk.gov.az/uploads/doc/docs/old/f04dbadd8f5b36d1772c8365d5a7de07.pdf: rule 1.3 allows acceptance only by smelting/alloy facilities registered as hazard-potential objects; rule 1.4 requires ID of private sellers; rule 1.5 requires a known source; rule 1.6 requires reporting to police/102. Tax Ministry notes undocumented operations in the sector (taxes.gov.az/az/post/1516).
candidates.existing: None seen; competitor search returned only the decision text
candidates.known_note: Rejected on the rule itself: acceptance is limited to a handful of registered smelters, so the small-dealer buyer pool is near zero.
candidates.name: Metal scrap acceptance points: radiation checks, source-of-scrap register, police reporting
candidates.trigger: Law on production and household waste art. 12-2; Cabinet Decision 39/2021
candidates.unchecked: Whether any non-smelter collection points still operate under subcontract; the decision's record-keeping annexes were not read in full.

candidates.evidence: AQTA publishes weekly lists of unlicensed slaughter points (afsa.gov.az, 10-13 and 17-21 June 2025); Nov 2025 Baku market seller found without food-safety registration (azertag.az/xeber/4355377); Food Safety Law 523-VIQ in force 1 Jan 2023, registration under Presidential Decree 2442.
candidates.known_note: Same buyer group (small food businesses) and same duty (food-safety registration and records).
candidates.name: Meat sale and animal slaughter points: AQTA food-safety registration and weekly enforcement

candidates.known_note: Same idea; no new deadline found.

candidates.name: Veterinary pharmacy compliance pack (Decision No. 19 requirements, prescription and sales records, product registration)

candidates.buyer: Companies employing foreign workers, plus agencies placing them

candidates.name: Employer annual foreign-worker quota report and work-permit renewals
candidates.trigger: State Migration Service quota and work-permit rules
candidates.unchecked: Number of small employers of foreigners; whether the State Migration Service portal already handles everything; competitor search not run.

candidates.evidence: Cabinet Decision 343 (17 Jul 2024) amended the annual financial report form; report due to the Ministry of Justice by 1 April with extra forms; donations to be reported within 15 days (Cabinet Decision 336 of 2015); cash donations capped at AZN 200 (icnl.org, csometer.info).
candidates.known_note: Sector is politically constrained and low-paying.
candidates.name: NGO annual financial report, grant registration and donation register filings
candidates.trigger: NGO law and Cabinet Decisions 336/2015 and 343/2024
candidates.unchecked: Number of active NGOs, willingness to pay, current rules for 2025-26 (the source said nothing newer than July 2024 was found).

candidates.evidence: Secondary source regalert.today/guides/fintech/AZ reports Central Bank Decision No. 59 of 25 Jun 2025: standard licence application, minimum capital AZN 300k-600k, electronic monitoring, AZN 20,000 daily limit for individuals, monthly operation and annual financial reports. Not confirmed on cbar.az; page fetch returned HTTP 429.
candidates.known_note: Capital requirement suggests few, better-capitalised buyers.
candidates.name: Currency exchange office licensing and monthly AML/transaction reporting
candidates.trigger: Central Bank Decision 59/2025 and 2018 control rules
candidates.unchecked: Primary text, number of licensed offices, whether reporting is through a central bank portal; competitor search not run.

candidates.trigger: Law on Children's Rights art. 29-1; Decision 68/2025

candidates.unchecked: Whether the rules were adopted and when; any metering or register duty.

candidates.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters

candidates.unchecked: Whether courses must report to traffic police, number of schools, any current regulation.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: No Azerbaijan domestic-worker registration or notification law surfaced (only Ukraine/Turkey results). Nothing found; no candidate.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Cabinet Decision No. 39 of 17 Feb 2021 (read in full from nk.gov.az PDF): only smelting/alloy facilities registered as hazard-potential objects may accept scrap, so small dealers are largely excluded by law. See rejected candidate.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: No Azerbaijani second-hand or pawnshop rules surfaced in search; nothing new beyond K04.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Not searched separately; nothing new beyond K05.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: No dismantler licence or permit rule found. Found end-of-life vehicle utilisation: utilizators in a registry, Cabinet decision 474 (25 Dec 2023) forms, utilisation fee since 1 Feb 2024. Small pool; weak candidate.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: No new rule found. AQTA says electronic identification and tracking are still 'preparatory work'. Nothing new beyond K10.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: AQTA runs weekly lists of unlicensed slaughter and meat-sale points (June 2025, 8 and 5 points, administrative protocols). Nov 2025 case of a market meat seller without food-safety registration. Same buyer and duty as K01.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: No Azerbaijani beekeeper registration or bee passport rule surfaced (only Turkey and Tatarstan). Nothing found.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: AQTA Collegium Decision No. 19 sets requirements for organising and running veterinary pharmacies; Cabinet fee schedule for registering vet products. Text not read. One unverified candidate.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Subsoil permits for individual wells run by direct negotiation (2000 Cabinet decision); Ministry of Ecology says new rules for artesian and subartesian wells are being drafted (undated). Unverified candidate.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: No waste-hauler licence or e-waste register rule found in search. Nothing found.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Lift certification and inspection sits with the state standards agency (building owners or servicers apply). No pressure-vessel source found. Gas: new Technical Regulation TR 001/2026/AZ and a gas-distributor inspection registry (Law 486-VIQD, art. 18). Weak candidate.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: No search spent; budget used on other categories.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: No dealer record-keeping or registration rule found; only the 2024 VAT-exemption list and the old pesticide registration decree. Nothing found.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: No licensing rule for recruitment or overseas-placement agencies found. Employers of foreigners must file annual labour-quota reports online (due 1 May for the next year) and hold work permits (Fragomen). One weak candidate.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: New Rules for Establishment and Management of Cemeteries in force: deceased entered in a state registry before plot allocation, no advance reservation, municipalities oversee (JAM News). No funeral-bureau licence found. Weak candidate.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: NGOs must file annual financial reports with the Ministry of Justice by 1 April (Cabinet decision 343 of 17 Jul 2024 amended the form), register grants, and report donations within 15 days. Halal and kosher not searched.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Only route-board signage rules for regular passenger vehicles found. Taxi permits already known (K11). No tachograph or permit change found.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Central Bank Decision No. 59 of 25 Jun 2025 reportedly standardises currency-exchange licences (capital AZN 300k-600k, monthly reports, AML) per a secondary source (regalert.today), not confirmed on cbar.az. Bazaar traders already known (K12).

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Nurseries: Cabinet Decision No. 68 of 10 Mar 2025 on quality requirements for child institutions; 63 private kindergartens got grants for 2025-26. Driving schools: no licence or journal source found. Small food producers: K01. Tattoo studios and hunting outfitters not searched.
